quirks.condition: A recount (W) in any round after the first.
quirks.effect: Each candidate's tally is seeded with floor(that candidate's final tally in the previous recount / 4), where the final tally is the tally at elimination or, for the winner, at the end; round 1 seeds are zero. The running-leader path never uses the seed. The spec says rounds are independent.

quirks.condition: Two or more surviving candidates tie for the fewest votes during a recount.
quirks.effect: The candidate with the longest id is eliminated first; among equal lengths, the last registered. The spec breaks ties by last registered only.

quirks.condition: During a recount, a ballot that ranks every registered candidate.
quirks.effect: It counts 2 votes while it stands on its first choice and 1 vote after transferring to a later choice; the running-leader path counts every ballot as 1.

quirks.condition: During a recount, a ballot with exactly two entries whose first choice is eliminated.
quirks.effect: The ballot is discarded instead of transferring to its second choice; ballots of other lengths transfer as the spec describes.

quirks.condition: A V ranking that contains an entry naming an unregistered candidate.
quirks.effect: The unknown entry is dropped and the remaining entries are processed; the ballot is rejected N <entry> CAND, echoing the first unknown entry, only when no entry survives. The spec rejects on the first unknown entry.

quirks.condition: A candidate id that differs only in letter case from one already registered, in a C command or a ballot entry.
quirks.effect: It refers to the existing candidate, and every reply reports the first-seen spelling; the spec treats ids as case-sensitive.

quirks.condition: A C or V command with extra tokens after the documented ones.
quirks.effect: The extra tokens are ignored and the command is processed (W stays strict); the spec rejects them as malformed.

unmapped_families.reason: Held-out mixed corpus exercising every quirk together with spec-accurate paths; no single quirk maps to it.
